summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release updating progress on its EUR 1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During the week of 15-19 June 2026, the company repurchased 1,500,000 shares at an average price of EUR 27.09, totaling EUR 40.6 million. To date, 12,200,000 shares have been bought back at an average price of EUR 25.85 for EUR 315.3 million, completing ~31.5% of the programme. The buyback aims to reduce share capital. This is a routine capital return update, not a new event. What to watch: continued execution against the EUR 1.0 billion authorization; weekly progress reports.
